strings.name: Hakeem Olajuwon
strings.summary: Olajuwon moved from Lagos to the University of Houston and played mainly for the Rockets. Footwork, fakes and defense defined his game. In 1994 he combined regular-season MVP, Defensive Player of the Year and Finals MVP, then retained the title in 1995. His Dream Shake influenced later players; he supported African basketball after retirement and exemplifies African-born achievement at basketball's highest level.
